notes.title: The splash scene has been changed.
notes.notes: The splash scene has been changed to display a simple production group name.

notes.title: Minor corrections to make the display easier to understand
notes.notes: Minor corrections to make the display easier to understand

notes.title: Change display text format etc.
notes.notes: [p]We've changed the display text format, and it now looks clearer in most scenes.[/p][p]We've also added a border to the text on the in-game phone screen, which we think makes it easier to read regardless of the animation color of our custom CPU.[/p][p]Also, due to a change in Twitch's specifications, the previous method was no longer able to obtain chat content, and as a result viewers were no longer able to choose where to place their stones. As a result, we've changed the procedures to reflect the change in specifications and have explained them in the instructions.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed some bugs in the board display
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs in the board display

notes.title: Stabilized online battles
notes.notes: [p]We have fixed potential issues that may have arisen due to the timing of updates and have stabilized the operation of online battles. We believe that the game will function stably even in battles involving complex procedures, such as 5 vs. 5 battles. If you find any bugs, please report them on the message board.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed some bugs when rejoining a custom match
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs when rejoining a custom match

notes.title: Added the ability to toggle the post-match settings screen on/off.
notes.notes:
To make it easier to check the ending status, the settings screen that appears after a match can now be toggled ON/OFF.
Additionally, some bugs related to quick match have been fixed.

notes.title: When re-entering the room, the waiting time is skipped when data loading is comp
notes.notes: The re-entry waiting time has been changed from a fixed 3 seconds to no waiting time if the data loading completion report is received.

notes.title: Some online room status synchronization adjustments
notes.notes: [p]Some online room status synchronization adjustments, some input field adjustments[/p]

notes.title: Added explanation of the basic rules of Reversi to the manual
notes.notes: [p]Added explanation of the basic rules of Reversi to the manual[/p]

notes.title: A CPU vs CPU mode has been added, allowing matches between AI players
notes.notes: [p]CPU VS CPU' mode is now available! Let your AI players battle it out, compare their performances, and develop even stronger or more fun-to-watch opponents. You might even start by designing a character's battle animation, then imagine how they'd play and build their AI from there![/p]

notes.title: Introduced an allow list of components that can be loaded.
notes.notes: To prevent the execution of unauthorized code, we have introduced an allow list for components that can be loaded. Please check the in-game manual to see which components are allowed to be attached to the stones, boards, and backgrounds you have created. There should be no problem with normal creation, but if there are any additional components you would like to see added to the allow list, please comment on this game's message board on Steam. Additionally, a change has been made so that a confirmation screen is displayed before clearing the input for user-added items in CPU management and theme management.

notes.title: Added rewards and updated manual
notes.notes: Added rewards and updated manual

notes.title: Changed display of active reward conditions in CPU versus versus mode settings
notes.notes: Changed the display of active reward conditions in CPU vs. Battle Mode Settings to make it easier to see which reward conditions correspond to the currently selected battle mode.

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.notes: Steam Deck is now supported. Please use the Steam Deck's on-screen keyboard function for text input. Please refer to the in-game manual for instructions on how to use custom themes and custom CPUs using SD cards.

notes.title: Added controller description to the manual
notes.notes: Added controller description to the manual

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes: You can now use a controller to control the on-screen cursor. The cursor will disappear when you click the mouse. The cursor will reappear when you use the controller's movement keys. Button settings etc. can be configured on the Controller screen in the game's title screen settings. The settings made in the controller layout on Steam will not be reflected.

notes.title: Changes to the file browser
notes.notes: The file browser has been changed. This change is for future Steam Deck support.

notes.title: Achievements feature added
notes.notes: Achievements have been added. Currently in early access, achievements will be added over time until the full release.

notes.title: Steam Cloud support
notes.notes: Steam Cloud is now supported. Save data can now be shared across multiple devices. To use this feature, you must enable both the account cloud and the app (REVERSI xVSx) cloud. This data is saved on the Steam Cloud when the game ends, and is loaded when the game starts.

notes.title: Testing Steam cloud deployment
notes.notes: Testing Steam cloud deployment

notes.title: Changes have been made to separate save data for each Steam user.
notes.notes:
We have made a change so that save data is separated by Steam user.
As a result, all previous saves will be initialized.
The same applies to the DEMO version.
Considering that current sales figures are in the single digits and the number of active players is almost zero, we do not think that many people will be affected, but if you would like to restore your saves, please ask in the requests thread on the message board, and we will explain the steps to manually restore your saves.

In addition, due to changes to the save data structure, the Early Access version will undergo detailed updates to make it compatible with Steam Cloud. We will make another announcement when cloud-compatible functionality has been implemented in the Early Access version.[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900617/9156d1b71c595215fa46a20a5f7a1392c3634683.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900617/324ab1db29c26351c96e78bb22df252fdf869dbc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Measures have been taken to improve stability during online battles.
notes.notes: We have become more strict in checking for data corruption when exchanging data during online battles, and some code changes have been made as a result. If you notice any strange behavior, please report it on the message board.

notes.title: Early Access has begun
notes.notes: Our game REVERSI xVSx entered early access today, December 10, 2024.

notes.title: New opponent: Witch added
notes.notes: Added a new opponent, the Witch, that can be acquired by playing against the CPU (Early Access version only, not added to the demo version)

notes.title: Adjustments to the drawing order of stones and boards, etc.
notes.notes: Adjusted the drawing order of stones and boards, and added a (Tips) section to the manual accordingly.

notes.title: UI changes etc.
notes.notes: Reward acquisition conditions are now displayed when you hover your cursor over the key icon of an unearned reward. Other minor changes were made, such as making the image lighter. If you have any other requests, please let us know on the bulletin board.

notes.title: Significant changes to user interface (UI)
notes.notes: We have made major changes to the user interface. As a result, the layout of interactive buttons and items has been organized. Minor corrections will be made from time to time.

notes.title: Added CPU management
notes.notes:
Addition of CPU management: By using CPU management, you can add or delete the battle CPU list.
This allows you to select your own CPU from [>] in the same way as the built-in CPU.

notes.title: Addition of CPU homebrew function
notes.notes: A function has been implemented in which you can create your own CPU using your own videos and your own thought routine (creation assistance function has been implemented) and compete against that CPU. If you publish the data of your own CPU on the creator's site, other owners of this software can also compete against you.

notes.title: Addition of new opponents (CPUs) that can be obtained by playing against CPUs.
notes.notes:
Addition of new opponents (CPUs) that can be obtained by playing against CPUs. 
Improvement of the CPU search program. Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Implementation of CPU battle rewards
notes.notes: You can now get rewards by meeting the reward acquisition conditions by playing against the CPU.　Try your best to earn rewards!

notes.title: Added theme management, updated MANUAL
notes.notes:
Since theme management has been added, the specification of the theme to be used is set to not be used.
You can also set stones etc. loaded from local files to be selectable in the same way as the built-in theme.
The updated instructions should make it a little easier to understand how to import self-made stones etc. into the game.
